name: default
description: Generic profile for any document domain. Includes common report sections and does not exclude result/discussion chapters.

scan_fields.tags: Keyword tags: explicit technical terms, processes, entities, or abbreviations.
scan_fields.summary: One-paragraph summary based only on visible allowed sections.
scan_fields.entities: Named entities, company names, project names, product names, abbreviations, and codes, exactly as written.
scan_fields.client_name: Client or customer name when explicitly present; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.project_name: Project name when explicitly present; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.product_capacity: Product type and capacity/scale when explicitly present; otherwise '原文未提及'.
scan_fields.quality_summary: Key quality or specification metrics, preserving original names, values, and units.
scan_fields.objective: Primary objective or goal from the objectives section.
scan_fields.process: Process, method, or workflow route from the methods section.
scan_fields.key_data: Key numeric metrics with original units, preferring table values.
scan_fields.conclusion_chunk_id: Internal conclusion chunk pointer. AI-only, never employee-visible.
